invariants.rationale: The method always creates and returns a new LinkedHashMap, so result should never be null.
The set of keys in result is determined by the set of partitions assigned to records by the partitioner.
Every record in every list value of result originally came from dedupedRecords.
No new records are introduced: every record in the output must come from the input dedupedRecords.
If there are no input records, the returned map must also be empty.
